build.name: make rs (static release) in the preserved gcc 4.9 world
build.cmd: make -s rs 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -5; ls minisat* 2>/dev/null | head; test -x ./minisat_static -o -x ./minisat && echo built

runs.name: satisfiable CNF
runs.cmd: B=./minisat_static; test -x $B || B=./minisat; $B $HARNESS/sat.cnf 2>&1 | tail -3; echo exit=$?

runs.name: unsatisfiable CNF
runs.cmd: B=./minisat_static; test -x $B || B=./minisat; $B $HARNESS/unsat.cnf 2>&1 | tail -3; echo exit=$?

notes: Same fixtures as minisat-2.2.0 / picosat-965 / zchaff-2007.
